ja: 『鬼滅の刃』より、プラモデル初心者でも簡単に組み立てられる「鬼滅模型」に我妻善逸がラインアップ！
タンポ印刷や塗装済パーツを採用し、組み立てやすさと高クオリティを両立！
• 接着剤不要の簡単組み立て。プラモデルが初めての方も不慣れな方も安心して楽しめる。
• 羽織や脚絆の柄や色分けは塗装済パーツを採用し、組み立てるだけでカラフルな仕上がりに。
• 目や眉はライトユーザーでも安心なタンポ印刷で再現。毛先の色分けは塗装済パーツで表現。
• 隊服のシワ、羽織の翻った表現など、固定モデルだからこそできるこだわりの造形。
• 必要な道具はニッパー(別売り)だけで、パズル感覚で楽しく組み立てができる。
• 別売りの「鬼滅模型」アイテムと並べてディスプレイすることで劇中のイメージを演出。
en: From "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba", Zenitsu Agatsuma is joining the lineup of "Demon Slayer Models" that can be easily assembled even by plastic model beginners!
Adopts pad printing and pre-painted parts to achieve both ease of assembly and high quality!
• Easy assembly without adhesive. People who are new to plastic models and those who are inexperienced can enjoy it with confidence.
• The pattern and color coding of the haori and leg ties are made of pre-painted parts, creating a colorful finish just by assembling them.
• Eyes and eyebrows are reproduced with tampo printing that is safe even for light users. The color coding of the tips of the hair is expressed with painted parts.
• The wrinkles on the uniform, the flaps of the haori, and other details that can only be achieved with a fixed model.
• The only tool you need is nippers (sold separately), and you can enjoy assembling it like a puzzle.
• Create an image from the play by displaying it alongside the separately sold "Demon Slayer Model" item.
